rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v1.4.3**: Added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains as header
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a structured element, containing another generic element as part of its header, and that other element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: atom element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Literal text that is part of the document body.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Similarly to `po:Inline`, elements following the 'atom' pattern can only be contained within block or inline elements (and consequently they also cannot be used as root elements of documents). It can contain textual content and no other elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: non-structured element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that cannot contain other elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element concerning the structural organization of a document.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
Elements following this pattern contain no textual content and contain only elements compliant with the patterns: `po:Meta`, `po:Field`, `po:Block` and any subtype of `po:Container`.
It is disjointed with the pattern `po:Popup`, although they share the same content model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pattern-based element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An atomic component of a document that is able to capture a recurrent and well knwon structure of a document.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Any entity belonging to this class is compliant with exactly one structural pattern.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: can contain homonymous elements
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An indication whether a hierarchical-based entity contains al least two entities that share the same name or not.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can contain other elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: headed-container element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A container element whose content model needs to begin with one or more block elements (the heading).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a structured element containing another generic element, and that other element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: block element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that organises the document content as a sequence of nestable elements and text nodes.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
In particular, elements following this pattern can contain text and other elements compliant with the patterns `po:Inline`, `po:Atom`, `po:Milestones` and `po:Popup`.
Furthermore, it is a requirement that block elements are contained only by container and popup elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is contained by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that is contained by another structured element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: non-textual element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that cannot have textual content in its content model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The name of a particular element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: field element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Literal metadata or text that is not really part of the document body.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Its main difference with `po:Meta` is that `po:Field` can contain textual content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inline element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that organises the document content as a sequence of nestable elements and text nodes, and that can contain other elements compliant with the same pattern.
rdf:Description.skos:note:
This class has the same use and content model of the pattern Block, but differing primarily because a) inline elements can contain other elements compliant with the same pattern while block elements cannot, and b) inline elements must always be contained by other block or inline elements and by no other type of element.
These constraints also imply that inline elements cannot be used as root elements of documents and that the class Block is disjoint with the class Inline (i.e., a markup element cannot be a block and an inline at the same time).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: meta element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that contains neither other elements nor textual content.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Contrarily to the pattern `po:Milestone`, which was meant to describe markup elements that impact the document because of their location, the main feature of its disjoint sibling is the mere existence, independently from the position it has within the document. `po:Meta` elements convey metadata information about the document or part of it, independently of where they are. Thus, meta elements can be contained only within container elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mixed element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can contain other elements and text nodes.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: textual element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can have textual content in their content models.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: milestone element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An elements that contains neither other elements nor textual content.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bucket element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can contain other elements but no text nodes.

rdf:Description.skos:note:
Similarly to `po:Inline`, elements following the `po:Milestone` pattern can only be contained within block or inline elements (and consequently they also cannot be used as root elements of documents).
The distinctive characteristic of the pattern `po:Milestone` is the location it assumes within the document.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: table element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A container element that must contain only homogeneous elements (but they can be repeated).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: flat element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can contain text nodes but no elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: popup element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A bucket element that is only present within block and inline elements.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Popup elements are used whenever complex structures need to be placed within content elements such as paragraphs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: can contain heteronymous elements
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An indication whether a hierarchical-based entity contains al least two entities having different names or not.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: marker element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element that can contain neither text nodes nor elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: record element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A container element that can only contain heterogeneous and non repeatable elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is contained by as header
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an element, contained by another structured element as part of its header, and that other element.
